content: The College Health Portal monitors aggregated, anonymized health telemetry across student housing dormitories. Sudden spikes in tachycardia or respiratory anomalies trigger campus health advisories.
In a campus medical emergency, dispatches route simultaneously to Campus Security, the Student Health Center Infirmary, and designated Resident Assistants (RAs).
Students flagged with persistent high risk scores or medication non-compliance can be scheduled for confidential check-ins at the Campus Student Wellness Center.
